definitions: A placeholder or empty field in a user interface that is intended to be filled with a specific choice or value.
An unlabeled selection choice within a set of options, often indicating that no specific option has been chosen yet.
examples: The form displayed a blank option label for the user to select their preferred color.
If you don't make a selection, the system defaults to the blank option label.
She clicked on the blank option label to reveal the dropdown menu.
